messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — AWS Marketplace invoice for Feb looks off. Charged to Redwood-Prod acct = $47,182 but our usage report shows $42,109. Anyone else seeing this?
Elaine Gomez: Yep, noticed this earlier. AWS emitted two invoice pieces (listing + usage) and there’s a negative promotion line that didn’t flow through to the partner credit. Timing/partner-application mismatch.
Oscar Liu: I pulled the marketplace billing CSV and Metering Report. Our raw usage before promotions = $45,900. After our reseller discount it should be $42,109. Do you have the raw AWS invoice lines?
Maya Patel: Pasting the AWS invoice summary from the portal:
```
ChargeType | Amount
Marketplace usage | $45,900.00
Listing fee | $1,500.00
Marketplace promotion | -$999.00
Tax | $781.00
Total | $47,182.00
```
Maya Patel: AWS math matches, but the partner credit from ChannelPartnerX is $42,109 which equals our expected net excl listing & tax. So there’s a $5,073 gap.
PartnerOps Bot: New inbound invoice uploaded: s3://invoices/channelpartnerx/2026-02.pdf :paperclip: 
Samir Rao: Quick Q — are taxes included or passed through by partner? AWS sometimes lists VAT separately and partners either absorb or pass-through. Our GL expects VAT separate.
Elaine Gomez: Partner invoice only credits ‘Marketplace usage’ line. They flagged listing fee as non-refundable per onboarding T&C. Need confirmation from ChannelPartnerX.
Oscar Liu: Proposed plan: 1) Reconcile meter CSV -> invoice line by line (I’ll attach my recon). 2) If partner omitted tax/listing incorrectly, request credit memo. 3) If contractually non-refundable on listing, book $1,500 to Product Sales Expense and hold tax in Suspense.
Maya Patel: Don’t book anything until partner responds. Elaine — open a partner support ticket, request itemized credit memo for listing+tax or contractual explanation. CC procurement/legal.
Elaine Gomez: Ticket created: https://partners.redwood/support/CHX-4721 — pinged ChannelPartnerX billing and Legal, asked for response within 48h. :clock1: 
Samir Rao: If they push back, we may need to escalate to AWS since AWS billing should reflect promotions and partner credits consistently. I can open an AWS case.
Oscar Liu: If no reply in 48h I’ll prep a JE template to move the $5,073 delta to suspense so month-end closes.
Maya Patel: Please add estimated GL impact in the ticket so FP&A can approve quick suspense posting if needed.
Elaine Gomez: Partner replied — they say listing fee non-refundable and tax is remitted to tax authority and cannot be credited. Attached reseller clause.
Maya Patel: Ask for formal credit memo for the marketplace promotion difference ($999) and a written explanation for tax treatment. If they refuse listing refund, we’ll book listing + tax per Oscar’s note.
PartnerOps Bot: ChannelPartnerX responded with attachment: s3://invoices/channelpartnerx/response_CHX-4721.pdf
Samir Rao: Opening AWS Marketplace support case to verify tax handling and whether AWS can reissue corrected invoice if promotions weren’t applied at settlement.
Maya Patel: Next steps: Elaine to confirm credit memo status in CHX-4721 (48h), Samir to open AWS case if partner won’t credit tax/listing, Oscar to prepare JE template. I’ll approve temporary suspense booking after ticket deadline passes. :thumbsup: 
Elaine Gomez: Will update CHX-4721 and loop in Legal if partner refuses credits.
Oscar Liu: Uploaded reconciliation CSV to /finance/billing/reconciliations/2026-02-aws-marketplace-recon.csv and draft JE to /finance/journal-entries/drafts/JE-2026-02-marketplace-suspense.draft.
Maya Patel: Closing loop once partner responds. If you need my sign-off on a credit memo approval, @Maya Patel available. :eyes:
